Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class T3270

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.T3270
public class T3270 extends Object
3270 Terminal-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_3270 section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0xfd.
